principle: The priority surface answers what deserves attention now. AgentOS execution labels must come from synced canonical workstreams, never from assumptions.
portfolio_constraint: Do not start a new standalone product until at least one of the current top three priorities reaches its current proof milestone. Capture new ideas to backlog only by default.

staleness_policy.rule: A stale synced workstream must not continue to present as confidently underway unless an explicit waiting/external-dependency state explains the gap.

priorities.outcome: Prove the enforcement boundary well enough to earn the first design partners.
priorities.owner_next: Review proof gates and partner-facing decisions that require founder judgment.
phase_done_when: Remaining enforcement proof gates are completed or explicitly dispositioned.
The product can make a narrow evidence-supported enforcement claim.
10 qualified prospects are researched and ranked.
At least 3 design-partner conversations or outreach attempts are initiated with owner approval.

priorities.outcome: Make the agent workforce reliably execute work without creating more founder overhead.
priorities.owner_next: Intervene only where execution is blocked, approval is required, or the system cannot reconcile itself.
phase_done_when: Bounded work can be handed off without creating equivalent coordination work.
Deterministic failures reconcile without founder interruption where safe.
Workspace receives trustworthy execution projection from AgentOS.
Blocked, approval-required, underway, stale, and complete states surface clearly.

priorities.outcome: Prove that persistent context creates measurable user value, not just a better product surface.
priorities.owner_next: Prioritize user friction, Context/Reflect usefulness, imports, and measurable context lift over new feature breadth.
phase_done_when: The Context + Reflect journey is materially frictionless for intended beta users.
Import/seed flows reduce repeated setup.
At least one measurable context-value signal is captured, such as Re-explanation Rate or Context Lift.
Progress is judged by user value rather than feature count.

priorities.outcome: Operate the portfolio and preserve evidence; do not turn ASHWOOD into another startup to feed.
priorities.owner_next: Use Workspace as the operating surface and Build Journal as the public evidence trail.
phase_done_when: Workspace reliably answers what matters, what agents are doing, and what needs the owner.
Build Journal preserves a clear evidence trail without becoming copy-heavy.
ASHWOOD remains an operating/evidence surface rather than a new startup obligation.

priorities.outcome: Prove the observe → insight → recommended work → AgentOS routing → outcome loop before expanding the product.
priorities.owner_next: Avoid broad feature expansion until the intelligence loop is repeatedly grounded in real portfolio activity.
phase_done_when: Real portfolio activity is observed.
A grounded opportunity, risk, drift, or work item is identified and explained.
Recommended work routes into AgentOS or an owning system.
The outcome of the intervention can be tracked.

priorities.outcome: Turn real build lessons into practical education without competing with the builds for attention.
priorities.owner_next: Document and teach from work that already happened; do not create curriculum work merely to keep the surface busy.
phase_done_when: Real lessons from completed or active builds are captured as practical learning material.
The education layer remains downstream of execution rather than creating independent delivery pressure.
